description: This file provides shared reply-history helper functions and type definitions for plugins managing per-thread context windows in a larger project.

methods.name: buildHistoryContext
methods.description: Constructs a history context object using provided entries or parameters.

methods.name: buildHistoryContextFromEntries
methods.description: Creates a history context from a list of history entries.

methods.name: buildHistoryContextFromMap
methods.description: Builds a history context from a map of entries.

methods.name: buildPendingHistoryContextFromMap
methods.description: Prepares a pending history context based on a map of entries.

methods.name: clearHistoryEntries
methods.description: Removes all history entries from the context.

methods.name: clearHistoryEntriesIfEnabled
methods.description: Clears history entries if the feature is enabled.

methods.name: evictOldHistoryKeys
methods.description: Removes outdated or excess history keys to maintain size limits.

methods.name: recordPendingHistoryEntry
methods.description: Records a new pending history entry.

methods.name: recordPendingHistoryEntryIfEnabled
methods.description: Records a pending history entry if the relevant feature is enabled.
